label: Concentric Pulse
author: Conky-Studio
description: Expanding concentric rings from a centre — sonar / ripple effect. Speed and intensity follow Trigger.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {max_radius}
 local n = math.floor({ring_count} + 0.5)
 local energy = 0.3 + 0.7 * (math.min(tonumber({trigger}) or 0, 100) / 100)
 local t = wall_clock() * {speed}
 local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, {line_width})
 for i = 0, n - 1 do
  local phase = (t + i / n) % 1
  local rad = R * phase
  local fade = (1 - phase) * energy
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * fade)
  cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, rad, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 -- centre blip
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * energy)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, 3, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
